meta.title: TMUA Question Bank
meta.coverage: 2016–2023 historic papers and early specimen papers. 360 questions, with official worked solutions. Recent computer-based sittings are not part of the downloadable archive.
meta.topicNote: Topic labels are study aids inferred from the question and solution; they are not official classifications.
meta.distribution: This package contains metadata and viewing software. Official PDFs are downloaded directly from the publisher for personal study.
